fields.name: Ssendam, Lord of Madness
fields.resist: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder
fields.immune: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Aura of Madness
trait.text: Any creature (other than undead or constructs) that ends its turn within 10 feet of Ssendam must make a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be inflicted with a random short-term madness. If a creature succeeds against any madness ability of Ssendam's, they are immune to Ssendam's madness for 1 hour.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
trait.text:
Ssendam's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). Ssendam can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

	• At will: detect good and evil, detect magic, detect thoughts, dispel magic, fear, fly, mass suggestion, plane shift
	• 2/day each: finger of death, flame strike
	• 1/day each: power word (any)

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Ssendam fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Ssendam has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
trait.text: Ssendam's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration (Golden Amoeba Form Only)
trait.text: Ssendam regains 40 hit points at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point.

trait.name: Shapechanger
trait.text:
Ssendam can use her action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, into a Small aberration that looks like a golden amoeba, or back into this, her golden slaad form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. She reverts to her true form if she dies. Her statistics in the humanoid forms, other than her size, are the same.

While in her amoeba form, Ssendam has the same statistics with the following changes. She can't take any actions (except her Shapechanger action), speak, or manipulate objects. She has a movement Speed. of 40 feet and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, Ssendam can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. She has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws, and has resistance to all damage except psychic and radiant.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Ssendam makes three attacks: one with her Touch of Madness and two with her chaos staff.

action.name: Chaos Staff
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage. The target must also make a DC 19 Constitution or be stunned. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns.

action.name: Summon Slaadi (1/Day)
action.text: Ssendam summons 1d4 + 1 death slaadi. A summoned slaad appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Ssendam, acts as an ally of Ssendam, and can't summon other slaadi. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Ssendam dies, or until Ssendam dismisses it as an action.

action.name: Teleport
action.text: Ssendam magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

action.name: Touch of Madness
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage. A target that fails a DC 20 Charisma saving throw is inflicted with a random short-term madness. If it is already mad, the existing madness is replaced with a random long-term madness.

reaction.name: Amoeba
reaction.text: When damaged, Ssendam can use her reaction to shapechange into her golden amoeba form and the damage is reduced to 0.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Ssendam can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Ssendam regains spent legendary actions at the start of her turn.

legendary.name: Chaos Staff
legendary.text: Ssendam makes one attack with her chaos staff.

legendary.name: Teleport
legendary.text: Ssendam uses her Teleport action.

legendary.name: Subversion (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Ssendam forces every creature suffering from madness within 60 feet of her to use their reaction to attack another creature within 5 feet of them.

fields.description:
Ramius Dangremond is the commander of the Hellriders of Elturel. He never wanted the position, but because of the many deaths within the ranks of the order, he had to step up. His friend and fellow Hellrider, Barachiel, was the main reason he was able to grow into a capable commander. The loss of his friend saddens Ramius, and the news of his imprisonment within the Nine Hells gnaws at his soul.

Ramius is a natural horseman and a gifted athlete. The soldiers he leads often say that there isn't anything that Ramius can't mount or ride. He's ridden horses, mammoths, and machines into battle. Loyalty, honor, and duty are virtues that Ramius upholds. He fears nothing other than losing those he cares for.

Ramius as a Contact:
Ramius doesn't have the personal ability to cast Plane Shift—instead, he has been given a magic item that allows him to visit with the party every few days. When he arrives, he brings general supplies such as food and water, and treats any wounds, curses, or diseases the party has (to the best of his ability). Afterwards, he offers a selection of useful magic items for purchase, or, if the party already has excess magic items, he offers to purchase them for keeping or disposal.

trait.name: Freedom of Movement
trait.text: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or grapples.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.text: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The kraken makes two attacks using its Tentacle, Fling, or a combination of the two.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by the kraken, the creature is swallowed and the grapple ends. While swallowed, a creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and takes 42 (12d6) fire damage at the start of the kraken's turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall into a space within 10 feet of the kraken and now have the prone condition. If the kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

action.name: Tentacle
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d4 + 8) fire damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 16). While grappled, the target also has the restrained condition. Any target that starts its turn grappled by the kraken takes 5 (2d4) fire damage. The kraken has five tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Fling
action.text: One Large or smaller object or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction, and now has the prone condition. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at a creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked down with the prone condition.

legendary.text: The kraken can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The kraken regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Appendage
legendary.text: The kraken makes a Fling attack.

legendary.name: Fire Breath (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: The kraken exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC

fields.name: Eriflamme
fields.immune: fire, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the Eriflamme fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The Eriflamme has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The Eriflamme makes four Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a Bite attack.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) piercing damage plus 33 (6d10) fire damage.

action.name: Reform
action.text: All the Eriflamme's fire elementals vanish and the Eriflamme reappears in one of their spaces. The Eriflamme's hit points are equivalent to the combined hit points of the fire elementals.

reaction.name: Split (2/Day)
reaction.text: As a reaction to taking damage, the Eriflamme can split into fire elementals and reduce the damage to 0. The Eriflamme can form up to 10 fire elementals, splitting its remaining hit points between them. The fire elementals appear in spaces adjacent to or within the Eriflamme's old location, and all act on the Eriflamme's initiative. They gain a +5 bonus to attack rolls and have the Eriflamme's Reform action.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The Eriflamme can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Eriflamme regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Slam
legendary.text: The Eriflamme makes a Claw attack, which deals force damage instead of slashing damage if it hits.

legendary.name: Fireglide
legendary.text: The Eriflamme moves up to half its speed. It can fly during this movement.

legendary.name: Chomp (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: The Eriflamme makes a Bite attack with advantage.

fields.name: Awful Fisher

trait.name: Flammable Blood
trait.text: If the fisher drops below 200 hit points, it gains vulnerability to fire damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If the fisher fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The fisher can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The fisher makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Retract Filament
action.text: One Huge or smaller creature grappled by the fisher's Adhesive Filament must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the fisher, and the fisher makes one Claw attack against it with advantage. Anyone else who was attached to the filament is released. Until the grapple ends on the target, the fisher can't use Adhesive Filament.

action.name: Adhesive Filament (Bonus Action)
action.text: The fisher extends a sticky filament up to 90 feet in a straight line, which adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature the filament adheres to has the grappled condition (escape DC 20), and ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The filament can be attacked (AC 16; 25 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). A weapon that fails to sever it becomes stuck to it, requiring an action and a successful DC 20 Strength check to pull free. Destroying the filament deals no damage to the fisher. The filament crumbles away if the fisher takes this bonus action again.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The fisher can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The fisher regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Slash
legendary.text: The fisher makes a Claw attack.

legendary.name: Spit
legendary.text: The fisher uses Adhesive Filament.

legendary.name: Reel In
legendary.text: The fisher uses Retract Filament.

trait.name: Hive Mind

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: Ekengarik regenerates 10 hit points at the start of her turn, unless she took radiant damage in the last round.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Ekengarik makes three Bite attacks. She can replace one of the attacks with an Acid Spray (if available) attack or a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's Strength score is reduced by 2 (1d4). The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

action.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Ekengarik spits acid at one creature within 60 feet of her, or two creatures within 60 feet of her and 5 feet of each other. Targets must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) acid damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a successful one.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Ekengarik casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

	• At will: Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Heroism, Magic Missile
	• 1/day each: Evard's Black Tentacles, Cone of Cold, Confusion, Dimension Door, Geas, Invisibility, Prismatic Wall, Slow

reaction.name: Hardened Carapace (Recharge 4-6)
reaction.text: When hit with an attack, Ekengarik temporarily hardens her carapace, reducing her speed to 0 and increasing her AC by 5 until the start of her next turn.

fields.spells: Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Heroism, Magic Missile, Evard's Black Tentacles, Cone of Cold, Confusion, Dimension Door, Geas, Invisibility, Prismatic Wall, Slow

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Crushing Hug
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 51 (8d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, Anacreda grabs it with both arms. The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 73 (12d10 + 7) necrotic damage at the start of each of Anacreda's turns. Anacreda can't make attacks while grappling a creature in this way.

action.name: Spinewall
action.text: Anacreda causes a 50-foot-long, 5-foot-wide row of bones to pierce the earth at a point within 120 feet of her. She chooses the direction of the line. The bones rise 10 feet into the air and form a solid wall. A 5-foot section of bone has an AC of 20 and 10 hit points.

action.name: Shattering Shriek (1/Day)
action.text: Anacreda shrieks loud enough to shatter stone and bone alike. Each creature within a 50-foot-radius sphere centered on Anacreda must make aDC 18 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 55 (10d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damageon a successful one. Unworked stone, exposed bone, andsimilar materials in the radius are shattered and turned intodifficult terrain.

fields.resist: acid; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Magic Resistance

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Waeloquay fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Water Form
trait.text: Waeloquay can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Waeloquay makes three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Whelm (Recharge 4-6)
action.text: Each creature in Waeloquay's space must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If it is Large or smaller, it also has the grappled condition (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe, unless it can breathe water. If the save is successful, the target is pushed out of Waeloquay's space. Waeloquay can grapple one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of Waeloquay's turns, each target grappled by it takes 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. A creature within 5 feet of Waeloquay can pull a creature or object out of it by taking an action to make a DC 22 Strength check and succeeding.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Waeloquay can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Waeloquay regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Flow
legendary.text: Waeloquay moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Crush (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: One creature that Waeloquay is grappling takes 44 (8d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Pummel (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Waeloquay makes a Slam attack with advantage.

fields.name: Brother Adramalech
fields.skill: Arcana +14, Deception +21, Insight +14, Intimidation +14, Persuasion +21, Religion +14
fields.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
fields.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Adramalech's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Adramalech has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Unbreakable Bond
trait.text: If Adramalech is reduced to 0 hit points while Brother Morax still lives, Adramalech regenerates 50 hit points at the start of his next turn. This regeneration is interrupted if Brother Morax is reduced to 0 hit points before the start of Adramalech's turn.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Adramalech makes four attacks using Mental Barrage. He can replace one of the attacks with Brain Freeze or Cone of Madness (if available).

action.name: Mental Barrage
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) psychic damage.

action.name: Brain Freeze
action.text: Adramalech attempts to overload the brain of a creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must make a DC 22 Intelligence saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures that fail the saving throw have the stunned condition for up to 1 minute. A stunned creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Cone of Madness (Recharge 4-6)
action.text: Adramalech unleashes visions in a 30-foot cone in front of him. All creatures in the cone must make a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. For up to 1 minute, creatures that failed the save can't take reactions and each turn must use their action to make a melee attack against the nearest creature. Creatures may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Conjure Effigy (Recharge 6) (Bonus Action)
action.text: Adramalech targets a creature, reading its thoughts and creating an effigy of a loved one in an unoccupied space that he can see within 60 feet of Adramalech. The effigy has 55 (10d10) hit points, an AC of 10, and ability scores of 10. It occasionally shouts for help, but otherwise takes no actions. While the effigy is alive, the target creature has disadvantage on attacks targeting Adramalech and any time the effigy takes damage, the target creature also takes an equal amount as psychic damage. If the effigy is killed, the target creature gains a level of exhaustion. If Adramalech is killed while effigies exist, they harmlessly melt into a warm sludge.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Adramalech can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Adramalech regains spent legendary actions at the start of his turn.

legendary.name: Barrage
legendary.text: Adramalech makes a Mental Barrage attack.

legendary.name: Mental Blocker
legendary.text: Adramalech fortifies the mind of a creature he can see within 60 feet of him, or himself. The target benefits as if the Greater Restoration spell has been cast on them and is granted resistance to psychic damage until the end of Adramalech's next turn.

fields.name: Brother Morax
fields.skill: Acrobatics +20, Athletics +21, Intimidation +11, Medicine +10, Stealth +13, Survival +10
fields.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
fields.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Brittle Spine
trait.text: For each Brittle Spine a creature has, the creature takes 3 (1d6) poison damage at the start of each of their turns, and when Morax activates Burrow or Deep Burrow. Spines can only be removed by a Regeneration spell or similar, or by killing Morax.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Adramalech's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Morax has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spined Hide
trait.text: Whenever Morax is hit with a melee attack, the attacker takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage and gains 1 Brittle Spine.

trait.name: Unbreakable Bond
trait.text: If Morax is reduced to 0 hit points while Brother Adramalech still lives, Morax regenerates 50 hit points at the start of his next turn. This regeneration is interrupted if Brother Adramalech is reduced to 0 hit points before the start of Morax's turn.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Morax makes four attacks using his Claw, Spine Fling, or a combination of the two.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage, and the target gains 1 Brittle Spine.

action.name: Spine Fling
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d12 + 6) piercing damage, and the target gains 1 Brittle Spine.

action.name: Deep Burrow
action.text: Morax immediately deals Brittle Spine ongoing damage to all creatures that have at least one Brittle Spine that he can see.

action.name: Bone Spikes (Recharge 6)
action.text: Morax shoves an arm into the ground, rapidly growing bones that erupt at a point he can see within 100 feet of him. Each creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save gain 2 Brittle Spines, while creatures that succeed only gain 1 Brittle Spine.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Morax can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Morax regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Claw
legendary.text: Morax makes a Claw attack.

legendary.name: Bone Splinters (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Morax gestures at a creature he can see that has at least 1 Brittle Spine. That creature must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or the number of Brittle Spines it has doubles.

legendary.name: Burrow (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Morax bristles the spines within a creature that he can see. The target immediately takes Brittle Spine ongoing damage.

fields.name: Abigor

fields.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
fields.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Abigor's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Abigor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Abigor makes four attacks using its Warhammer, Throwing Hammer, or a combination of the two.

action.name: Warhammer
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage.

action.name: Throwing Hammer
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage. Hammers thrown this way fall and stick into the ground after hitting their target and a new hammer appears in Abigor's hand.

action.name: Thunderous Slam (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Abigor causes all its hammers left on the battlefield to bristle with thunderous energy, exploding outwards with a roar. All creatures within a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on each hammer must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. Targets take 26 (4d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature is within multiple spheres, it must make the save multiple times, taking damage from each source.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Abigor can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Abigor regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Throw Hammer
legendary.text: Abigor makes a Throwing Hammer attack.

legendary.name: Call Thunder (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Abigor targets a hammer that it can see within 60 feet to let out a thunderous roar. Creatures within a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the hammer must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fields.description: Source:	Chains of Asmodeus p. 193

fields.name: Devorastus
fields.resist: cold, fire, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
fields.conditionImmune: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Devorastus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Ooze Cube
trait.text: Devorastus takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to Engulf and has disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the cube can be seen but have total cover. A creature within 5 feet of the cube can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the cube. Doing so requires a successful DC 21 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 35 (10d6) acid damage. The cube can hold only one Huge creature or up to six Large or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

trait.name: Sticky
trait.text: Devorastus can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Transparent
trait.text: Even when Devorastus is in plain sight, it takes a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot Devorastus if it has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter Devorastus' space while unaware of Devorastus is surprised by it.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Devorastus makes four attacks using its Pseudopod, Spit, or a combination of the two.

action.name: Pseudopod
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 42 (12d6) acid damage.

action.name: Spit
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (8d6) acid damage. A target hit by this attack must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the prone condition.

action.name: Engulf
action.text: Devorastus moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever Devorastus enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of Devorastus. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, Devorastus enters the creature's space, the creature takes 35 (10d6) acid damage, and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, has the restrained condition, and takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of Devorastus' turns. When Devorastus moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. An engulfed creature can try to escape by making a DC 21 Strength check as an action. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of Devorastus.

fields.skill: Arcana +20, History +20, Investigation +14, Perception +13, Sleight of Hand +9
fields.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
fields.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Contractually Obligated
trait.text: Rimmon has advantage to hit creatures under an infernal contract and when he hits such creatures he delivers an additional 9 (2d8) damage of a type the target is most vulnerable to. trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Rimmon's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Rimmon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d4 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Wordplay
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +14 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (6d8 + 8) psychic damage.

action.name: Connected Clauses (1/Day)
action.text: Rimmon emits a burst of energy that arcs towards a creature he can see within 150 feet of him. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target. A target must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (14d8) damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage type inflicted is of a type the first target is most vulnerable to.

A creature bound under an infernal contract also makes all saving throws against effects originating from Zagum with disadvantage.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Zagum's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Zagum has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Zagum makes three attacks with Disarming Tongue or Oration.

action.name: Disarming Tongue
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d4 + 3) slashing damage. A target hit by this attack has vulnerability to psychic damage until the start of their next turn.

action.name: Oration
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +14 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (6d8 + 8) psychic damage.

action.name: Legal Jargon (Recharge 4-6)
action.text:
Zagum chooses a point he can see within 90 feet of him. All creatures within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw. Creatures that fail the save are confused for up to 1 minute and must roll a d10 at the start of each of their turns.

On a 1, a creature moves in a random direction then ends their turn. On a 2-6, a creature can't use actions this turn. On a 7-8, a creature must use their action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within their reach that is not a Fiend. On a 9-10, a creature can move and act normally.

A confused creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

fields.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
fields.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Contractually Obligated
trait.text: Buer has advantage to hit creatures under an infernal contract and when she hits such creatures she delivers an additional 9 (2d8) damage of a type the target is most vulnerable to. A creature bound under an infernal contract also makes all saving throws against effects originating from Buer with disadvantage.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Buer's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Buer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Buer makes three attacks using her Claw. She can replace two of the attacks with a Cleansing Bite attack.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Cleansing Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage, healing Buer for an amount equal to the damage dealt.

action.name: Spectral Reaping (Recharge 6)
action.text: Buer focuses her ethereal form, dashing up to 50 feet in a straight line through the ethereal plane. Any creatures in the line must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Buer may reappear at any unoccupied space along the line. For 1 minute after using Spectral Reaping, Buer is empowered by ethereal essence. Her Cleansing Bite attack now deals force damage instead of bludgeoning.

action.name: Defensive Trip (Recharge 5-6) (Bonus Action)
action.text: Buer attempts to slow the actions of a creature she can see within 60 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be slowed until the end of its next turn. A slowed creature's speed is halved, it takes a -2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can't use its reactions. Regardless of the slowed creature's abilities or magic items, it can't make more than one melee or ranged attack during its turn.

reaction.name: Soul Exchange
reaction.text: When Buer is subjected to a spell targeting only her, she can attempt to swap places with a creature she damaged on her last turn. The creature must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature and Buer swap positions, and the spell now targets the creature instead of Buer.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Buer can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Buer regains spent legendary actions at the start of her turn.

legendary.name: Teamwork
legendary.text: Buer or one other devil within 60 feet of Buer makes a melee weapon attack against a target of Buer's choosing.

legendary.name: Backdoor Clause
legendary.text: Buer wreathes energy around a creature she can see within 60 feet of her. Until the end of Buer's next turn, the target is covered in fire or cold energy, Buer's choice. Each time the target is struck with a melee attack, the attacker takes 9 (2d8) fire or cold damage.

legendary.name: Refresh Souls (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Buer devours a Soul Coin, instantly refreshing one Recharge ability of any devil within 60 feet, including herself.

fields.description: Source:	Chains of Asmodeus p. 211

fields.name: Asmodeus
fields.skill: Arcana +16, Deception +28, Insight +28, Intimidation +19, Perception +19, Persuasion +19, Religion +16
fields.resist: cold
fields.immune: fire, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
fields.conditionImmune: blinded, charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

trait.name: Antimagic Aura
trait.text: Asmodeus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. Spells of level 4 or lower can't damage Asmodeus.

trait.name: Fiendish Regeneration
trait.text: Asmodeus regains 40 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Asmodeus dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate. If Asmodeus dies, his body regenerates, returning to life 13 (2d12) days later.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Asmodeus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Submission Aura
trait.text: When a creature moves to be within 120 feet of Asmodeus, they must succeed on a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until they leave the aura. While frightened, creatures kneel before Asmodeus, taking no actions unless he commands otherwise. If Asmodeus deals damage to a kneeling creature, the creature's frightened condition ends. A creature that succeeds the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Asmodeus makes four attacks using Ruby Rod, Chilling Gaze, or a combination of the two. He can replace one of the attacks with Hellish Smite.

action.name: Ruby Rod
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +21 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d8 + 12) necrotic damage, which also reduces the target's hit point maximum by the damage taken. This damage can't reduce a target's hit point maximum below 1. Any effect that removes a disease allows a creature's hit point maximum to return to normal.

action.name: Chilling Gaze
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +16 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) cold damage, and the target has a -1 penalty to all attack rolls they make until the end of their next turn. This penalty can stack.

action.name: Hellish Smite
action.text: Asmodeus targets a creature he can see within 300 feet of him, calling down a bolt of hellish lightning. The target must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Infernal Word: Stun (Recharge 4-6)
action.text: Asmodeus targets a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a DC 24 Intelligence saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that failed the save is stunned for up to 1 minute. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success, but taking the damage again on a failed save.

action.name: Hell-Lord's Suggestion (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Asmodeus targets a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a DC 24 Charisma saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that failed the save has the charmed condition for up to 1 minute. While charmed, a creature is controlled by Asmodeus, performing only actions that he suggests. A charmed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success, but taking the damage again on a failed save.

action.name: Fires of the Nine Hells (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Asmodeus chooses a point he can see within 500 feet of him, which explodes into a roaring inferno. All creatures within a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
Asmodeus casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 27):

	• At will: Bane, Bestow Curse, Command, Cure Wounds, Darkness, Lesser Restoration, Remove Curse
	• 1/day each: Antimagic Field, Earthquake, Flame Strike, Gate, Heal, Mass Heal, Wish

reaction.name: Ruby Absorption
reaction.text: As a reaction to being the sole target of a spell, Asmodeus can attempt to absorb the spell into the Ruby Rod. Asmodeus rolls (1d20 + 2), and if the result is higher than (10 + spell level), the spell is absorbed into the rod and has no effect.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Asmodeus can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Asmodeus regains spent legendary actions at the start of his turn.

legendary.name: Channel Ruby Rod
legendary.text: The Ruby Rod has 66 charges. Asmodeus may spend its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, with a spell save DC of 20: Lesser Restoration  (3 charges), Wall of Force (7 charges), Greater Restoration  (12 charges), Chain Lightning (15 charges), Prismatic Spray (23 charges), Globe of Invulnerability (33 charges)

legendary.name: Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Asmodeus makes a Ruby Rod attack.

legendary.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: Asmodeus summons an allied pit fiend in an unoccupied space that he can see.

fields.spells: Bane, Bestow Curse, Command, Cure Wounds, Darkness, Lesser Restoration, Remove Curse, Antimagic Field, Earthquake, Flame Strike, Gate, Heal, Mass Heal, Wish

fields.name: Baalzebul (CoA)
fields.resist: acid, cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Baalzebul's darkvision.

trait.name: Fiendish Regeneration
trait.text: Baalzebul regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Baalzebul dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Lord of Flies
trait.text: Insects don't attack Baalzebul, and he can issue orders to them.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Baalzebul fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Baalzebul has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Stench of the Slug (Slug Form Only)
trait.text: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of Baalzebul must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is immune to this stench for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Baalzebul uses Heart of Pestilence (if available), then makes three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Pungent Eruption (Slug Form Only, Recharge 4-6)
action.text: Baalzebul causes refuse and caustic liquid to spill from the ground at a point he can see within 300 feet. Each creature in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. Targets take 36 (8d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save have the poisoned condition for 1 minute.

action.name: Heart of Pestilence (Recharge 5-6)
action.text: Baalzebul channels pestilence into his body, sickening creatures within 50 feet that can see him. Sickened creatures must make a DC 21 Charisma saving throw, followed by a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. Failing the Charisma save makes a creature have the frightened condition, while failing the Constitution save makes a creature weak. While weakened, a creature deals half damage on melee attacks. Both effects last for 1 minute or until a Greater Restoration spell or similar is cast.

action.name: Spellcasting (Winged Form Only)
action.text:
Baalzebul casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 24):

	• At will: Animate Dead, Darkness, Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Dispel Evil and Good, Hallow, Hold Monster, Suggestion, Teleport, True Seeing
	• 1/day each: Symbol (pain or insanity), Wish

action.name: Displace (Bonus Action)
action.text: Baalzebul magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccu-pied space he can see.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Baalzebul can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Baalzebul regains spent legendary actions at the start of his turn.

legendary.name: Pummel
legendary.text: Baalzebul makes a Slam attack.

legendary.name: Teleport
legendary.text: Baalzebul uses Displace.

legendary.name: Insect Gorge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Baalzebul disgorges a swarm of biting flies at a point he can see within 300 feet of himself. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 44 (8d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The biting flies persist for 1 minute, or until Baalzebul uses this ability again. Creatures that enter the flies' area or end their turn inside it must repeat the saving throw.

legendary.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: Baalzebul summons an allied bone devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

fields.name: Belial
fields.skill: Athletics +15, Deception +25, Insight +14, Intimidation +17, Perception +14, Persuasion +25
fields.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
fields.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Deep Wounds
trait.text: All damage dealt by Belial can only be restored through magical means.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Belials darkvision.

trait.name: Fear Aura
trait.text: When a creature starts their turn within 120 feet of Belial, they must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until they leave the aura. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

trait.name: Fiendish Regeneration
trait.text: Belial regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Belial dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Belial fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Belial has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Belial makes three attacks using his Ranseur of Torture.

action.name: Ranseur of Torture
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach  10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's movement speed is reduced by 5 feet until the end of their next turn. This penalty can stack.

action.name: Walls of Phlegethos
action.text: Belial creates a wall of fire on a solid surface within 120 feet of him. The wall is 20 feet high and 1 foot thick, and Belial can make the wall up to 60 feet long or create a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter. The wall is opaque and lasts until Belial dismisses it. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that ends its turn inside the wall, or within 5 feet of it, must repeat the save.

action.name: Symbol of Insanity (Recharge 4-6)
action.text: Belial draws a magic symbol at a point he can see within 120 feet of him. All creatures within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the symbol must make a DC 25 Intelligence saving throw. Targets take 45 (10d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save immediately use their reaction to make a melee attack against a random creature within their reach, then move their full movement in a random direction.

reaction.name: Pleasure in Pain
reaction.text: As a reaction to taking damage, Belial immediately regenerates half the damage he took.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Belial can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Belial regains spent legendary actions at the start of his turn.

legendary.name: Ranseur
legendary.text: Belial makes a Ranseur of Torture attack.

legendary.name: Eruption (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Belial causes molten stone to erupt from a point he can see within 90 feet of him. All creatures within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: Belial summons an allied horned devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

fields.name: Dispater
fields.skill: Arcana +23, Insight +22, Intimidation +15, Perception +14, Persuasion +15, Stealth +11
fields.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
fields.resist: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
trait.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede Dispater's darkvision.

trait.name: Fear Aura
trait.text: When a creature starts their turn within 120 feet of Dispater, they must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until they leave the aura. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

trait.name: Fiendish Regeneration
trait.text: Dispater regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Dispater dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and is unable to regenerate.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Dispater fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Dispater has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rust Metal
trait.text: Any nonmagical weapon or ammunition made of metal that hits Dispater corrodes. After its hit, the weapon or ammunition is destroyed.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Dispater makes four attacks using his Wrought-Iron Tower, Iron Column, or a combination of the two. He can replace one of the attacks with Superheat Metal (if available).

action.name: Wrought-Iron Tower
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +20 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d8 + 12) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. Dispater may replace the bludgeoning damage with damage of a type that the target is vulnerable to instead.

action.name: Iron Column
action.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +15 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d8 + 12) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. Dispater may replace the bludgeoning damage with damage of a type that the target is vulnerable to instead.

action.name: Superheat Metal (Recharge 4-6)
action.text: Dispater targets a metal object he can see within 90 feet of him. The metal glows white-hot, burning all that touches it. If the object was held by a creature, the creature must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw to drop the object or take 45 (10d8) fire damage. If the object is attached to a creature, or they couldn't feasibly drop it, they automatically fail the save. The object returns to room temperature at the end of Dispater's turn.

action.name: Nail Spray (2/Day)
action.text: Dispater conjures a storm of iron nails and launches them forward in a 90-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line. All creatures within the line must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (16d4) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Nails launched from this ability stick into soft surfaces or fall to the ground after the attack finishes.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Dispater can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Dispater regains spent legendary actions at the start of his turn.

legendary.name: Staff
legendary.text: Dispater makes a Wrought-Iron Tower attack.

legendary.name: Flesh to Iron (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Melee Spell Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (6d10 + 7) force damage, and the target must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's flesh begins to harden, and the creature's movement speed is halved for 1 minute. If the creature is harmed by Flesh to Iron again, while still partly iron, the rest of the creature also turns to iron, killing them.

legendary.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: Dispater summons an allied erinyes in an unoccupied space that he can see.

fields.description: Source:	Chains of Asmodeus p. 222

fields.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
fields.resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Fear Aura
trait.text: When a creature starts their turn within 120 feet of Fierna, they must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until they leave the aura. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

trait.name: Fiendish Regeneration

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Fierna fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Fierna has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Princess of Hellfire
trait.text: Fire conjured by Fierna becomes Hellfire. It ignores resistances and immunities to fire damage, deals double damage to creatures vulnerable to fire or necrotic damage, can't be extinguished through any means, and is capable of melting stone or igniting inflammable objects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Fierna makes three attacks using Flame Blade, Mote of Flame, or a combination of the two.

action.name: Flame Blade
action.text: Melee Spell Attack: +20 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) fire damage.

action.name: Mote of Flame
action.text: Fierna targets a creature she can see within 90 feet of her. The target must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (3d8 + 9) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Wreath of Flames
reaction.text: When hit by a melee attack and Fierna can see her attacker, she covers herself in Hellfire, and the attacker takes 13 (3d8) fire damage.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Fierna can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Fierna regains spent legendary actions at the start of her turn.

legendary.name: Blade
legendary.text: Fierna makes a Flame Blade attack.

legendary.name: Conjure Hellfire (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Fierna chooses a point she can see within 150 feet of her. All creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: Fierna summons an allied spined devil in an unoccupied space that she can see.

fields.name: Glasya
fields.skill: Deception +25, Intimidation +17, Perception +15, Persuasion +17, Stealth +25, Survival +15
fields.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
fields.resist: cold, necrotic, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Charm Aura
trait.text: When a creature moves to be within 120 feet of Glasya, they must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition, treating Glasya as an ally, until they leave the aura. A creature that succeeds the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour. Whenever a charmed creature takes damage, they may repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Dominating Presence
trait.text: Glasya deals an additional 13 (2d12) psychic damage when attacking a charmed creature, and her attacks don't break charms.

trait.name: Fiendish Regeneration
trait.text: Glasya regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If she takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn. Glasya dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and is unable to regenerate. If Glasya is killed, her body slowly regenerates, returning to life 9 (2d8) weeks later.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
trait.text: If Glasya fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: Glasya has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Glasya makes four attacks using Scourge of Shadow, Necrotic Grasp, or a combination of the two. She can replace one of the attacks with Mesmerizing Gaze.

action.name: Scourge of Shadow
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +20 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d4 + 12) slashing damage, plus 5 (2d4) necrotic damage. This attack scores a critical on a roll of 18, 19, or 20.

action.name: Necrotic Grasp
action.text: Glasya summons necrotic hands to grope and claw at a creature she can see within 90 feet of her. The target must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw, taking 20 (2d10 + 9) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Mesmerizing Gaze
action.text: Glasya focuses her gaze in a 60-foot cone in front of her. Each creature of her choice within the cone must make a DC 23 Charisma saving throw or have the charmed condition until the end of their next turn. While charmed, creatures automatically fail saving throws from abilities used by Glasya and move to be as close to her as possible.

action.name: Deathly Exclamation (1/Day)
action.text: Glasya targets a creature she can see within 60 feet of her. The target must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw, taking 61 (7d8 + 30) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid killed by this ability rises at the start of Glasya's next turn as a zombie permanently under her command.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Glasya can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Glasya regains spent legendary actions at the start of her turn.

legendary.name: Whip
legendary.text: Glasya makes a Scourge of Shadow attack.

legendary.name: Disorient (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: Glasya casts Confusion (30-foot-radius, spell save DC 25), but only lasting until the end of Glasya's next turn.

legendary.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: Glasya summons an allied erinyes in an unoccupied space that she can see.

fields.name: Levistus
